title: Mrs Emily Sinico, accidentally killed at Sydney Parade railway station, 14 October 1903.
html_source: This incident is the climax of the story “A Painful Case” in Dubliners. In the “Hades” episode Bloom remembers that the last funeral he attended in that place (before Dignam’s) had been Mrs Sinico’s.
